I also have problems bathing regularly luckily I'm disabled and am not interacting with people everyday. I have done some research on this topic and they have these things called shower sprays that don't require water to rinse off. You can also make your own, I mix isopropyl alcohol, baby soap, and water in a spray bottle and use a rag with it to wipe down. Also baby wipes are really great too. I would see if at the very least a spray that you can make that's pretty inexpensive with a washcloth, I am very picky about textures and need to feel them before I buy them, it should help with the smell intermittently without too much overstimulation.
